name: firefly-iii
description: Operate a Firefly III personal-finance instance from an AI assistant. Bundles the MCP server registration, a skill teaching the 25-tool surface, four slash commands for common dashboards, and a categorization-audit agent. Covers the full Firefly III agentic surface, not just one workflow. Auth is MCP-spec OAuth — the client follows the discovery chain on first connect, no token paste needed. Reads the instance URL from the FIREFLY_URL environment variable.
